Privacy policy

What we collect, what we don't, and the current status of analytics

Reflex Hub is a registration-free static tool site. This page describes the data practices that actually exist in the current deployment; services that are not enabled are not described as if they were. Last updated: 2026-10-28.

1. What we do not collect

· There is no account system; we never ask for WeChat authorization, phone numbers, email or any personal profile;
· Parameters you type into the calculator (call volume, token usage, etc.) are computed entirely in your browser and are never uploaded to us;
· No form data collection runs on this site, and we do not sell data (there is no data to sell).

2. Browser local storage

· To remember your calculator preferences (selected models, off-peak toggle, cache hit rate), the calculator stores settings in your browser's localStorage on your own device; the data never leaves it;
· You can delete it anytime via "clear site data" in your browser; afterwards the tools return to default parameters;
· This site does not use cookies (there is no server session to maintain).

3. Analytics (current status: disabled)

· We plan to use Cloudflare Web Analytics for anonymous traffic statistics (no cookies, no personally identifiable information, no cross-site tracking);
· In the current deployment this feature is not enabled: no analytics beacon is loaded and your visits are not recorded by any statistics script;
· If it is ever enabled in the Cloudflare configuration, it will only be used to understand page traffic, and this section will be updated — without any popup asking for consent (the analytics itself collects no personal data).

4. Hosting and server logs

· This site is hosted on Cloudflare Pages. As the hosting and CDN provider, Cloudflare may process standard access logs (such as IP address, access time and request path) under its own privacy policy for security and traffic delivery;
· This site has no self-managed backend, cannot inspect those logs, and does not use them for any user analysis.

5. Third-party links

· "Official source" and "official site" links on model profiles and tool pages lead to vendor or third-party websites; once you click through, your visit is governed by their privacy policies, not ours;
· Outbound links carry no tracking redirects and no promotional parameters; the GitHub Issues feedback link likewise points to a third-party site.

6. Advertising and affiliate promotion

· Current status: this site carries no advertising — no ad account, no publisher ID, no ad scripts loaded (including Google AdSense), no ads.txt, no advertising cookies or identifiers;
· Affiliate promotion is likewise zero: no affiliate links exist; candidate partnerships are only under evaluation, as documented in the affiliate disclosure;
· If Google AdSense is ever introduced: ads may use cookies / device identifiers for frequency capping and fraud prevention; if personalized ads are served to users in the EEA, UK or Switzerland, a Google-certified consent management platform (CMP) will be deployed to collect and pass consent signals as Google requires — a homemade cookie banner is not a compliant substitute; before enabling, this page will be updated with an accurate list of the advertising and measurement technologies used;
· With or without ads, model pricing data comes only from vendors' public list prices, and presentation and ordering are unaffected by commercial relationships.

7. Policy changes and contact

This page is updated when the site's actual behavior changes; the date in the opening paragraph marks the latest update. For privacy questions, please open an issue on GitHub.
